native_contracts.0x004CCBB0: Selects group/entry with the E34C38/E36C70 table cursor, advances over entry NUL separators then leading bytes below 0x20, calls 0x004CC770, and clears D3B504. This traversal matches mapped 0x004CC110 pharaoh_text_select.
native_contracts.0x004CCE00: Calls 0x004CC5C0 for numeric text at output offset 1, optionally writes prefix at byte 0, scans the text through its NUL, appends the suffix, terminates, calls 0x004CC770, and clears D3B504.

reuse_review.old_project: generated/decompiled/src/Unit01696.c and Unit01700.c are wrappers back into Original004CC770/Original004CC5C0, so not complete C. Reused clean pharaoh_text_select (0x004CC110) and pharaoh_status_log_integer_to_text (0x004CC5C0) instead.

ghidra_types: void FUN_004ccbb0(int group,int entry,int x,int y,uint font_id,uint color)
void FUN_004cce00(int value,char prefix,char *suffix,int x,int y,uint font_id,uint color)
